description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementService class, which manages leave entitlements in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving leave balances, adding entitlements for employees, determining deletability of entitlements, and bulk assignment of entitlements. The class interacts with data access objects, configuration services, and implements business logic related to leave entitlement management.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementService
classes.description: Service class for managing leave entitlements, including retrieval, addition, deletion, and bulk operations.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementStrategy
methods.description: Returns the current leave entitlement consumption strategy, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of LeaveEntitlementDao, creating it if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIds
methods.description: Accepts an array of entitlement IDs and returns those IDs that are deemed deletable based on their usage.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Checks if a given LeaveEntitlement object is eligible for deletion.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave balance for a specific employee and leave type, optionally as of a specific date.

methods.name: addEntitlementForEmployee
methods.description: Adds or updates a leave entitlement for an employee over a specified date range.

methods.name: bulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Assigns the same leave entitlement to multiple employees over a date range in bulk.
